product_facts.name: Insta360 X6 | Midnight Black | Essentials Bundle | No microSD Card
product_facts.description: Includes our best-selling accessories for dynamic 360 shots. Includes 1× Insta360 X6, 1× Utility Fast Charge Case, 1× 114cm Invisible Selfie Stick, 2× Xtreme Batteries, and 1× Lens Cap, 1× USB-C Cable, and 1× Protective Pouch. Includes free Extended Warranty with 1 extra year of coverage. The 114cm Invisible Selfie Stick comes in one of two styles. Please refer to the item received.
